en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਸਦਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes hai satigur sach naau sadhavaiaa|

en.bdb: Salutation to that primal Lord who is known by the true name of Satigura.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan gursikh kar gurmukh sachaa pa(n)th chalaiaa|

en.bdb: Transforming all the four varnas into the Sikhs of the Guru, that true Guru (Gum Nanak Dev) has initiated a true way for the Gurmukhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਾਂਵਦੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat mil gaa(n)vadhe satigur sabadh anaahadh vaiaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru has vibrated such an unstruck word which is sung in the holy congregation by one and all.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੈਂਸਾਰ ਤਰਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur saakhee upadhes kar aap tarai sai(n)saar taraiaa|

en.bdb: The Gurmukhs recite the teachings of the Guru; they go across and make the world go across (the world ocean).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਥੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਚੂਨੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰੰਗੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paan supaaree kath mil choone ra(n)g sura(n)g chaRhaiaa|

en.bdb: As in betel leaf mixing of catechu, lime and betel nut makes a nice colour, similarly, gurmukh way of life consisting of all the four varnas is beautiful.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan simaran jugat gurmat mil gur pooraa paiaa|

en.bdb: He, who having met the perfect Gum has attained Gurmati; the wisdom of the Guru, has in fact identified the teachnique of knowledge, concentration and meditation.
The true Guru has established the abode of truth in the form of holy congregation.
